recent_excerpts: Kaspersky found hundreds of MovieReaper victims across 10+ countries after attackers poisoned itorrents.org, serving fake "The Odyssey" torrents that drop a Solana-C2 trojan.
Kaspersky found ValleyRAT delivered via fake adware installer that disables Defender and sideloads libcef.dll. Targets Chinese-speaking users.
Kaspersky dissects GenieLocker, a custom ransomware from the Toy Ghouls group, targeting Windows, Linux, and ESXi in attacks on Russian manufacturing firms since March 2026.
